description: University Grants Commission - Amendment to the Postgraduate Institute of Medicine Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content contains an ordinance made by the University Grants Commission under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends the Postgraduate Institute of Medicine Ordinance. This constitutes legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and amendments to existing legislation, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
